items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: since Jesse said it to me

ctx.x: Did you ever hear him? Chris Kelly, he was a jazz coach. Yeah, I heard him. He played on the style of Dixie Dan music. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. That's it. You ever heard this song, since Jesse said it to me, huh?
No, I don't believe it. You ever heard that?
